name: auto-docs
description: After each commit this session makes, reads the diff and updates README.md (or the docs you list) with small, safe edits in a follow-up docs commit.

docs.title: Documentation files
docs.description: Comma-separated paths from the repository root, such as README.md, docs/setup.md.

mode.title: After updating
mode.description: commit: a separate docs commit. stage: leave the changes staged for you to review.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that reads the diff and writes the edits.

maxDiffChars.title: Diff budget (characters)
maxDiffChars.description: Larger diffs are cut by whole files.
